h1: G3 cylinder and Megaflo enquiries in Ealing
title: G3 Engineer Ealing | Cylinder & Megaflo Help
description: Discuss Megaflo and unvented cylinder servicing or faults in Ealing. Share the postcode and model; call 020 7205 4433 to check availability.
answer: For Ealing no-hot-water enquiries, identify whether electricity or a connected heating source normally heats the cylinder.

sections.heading: Identify direct or indirect heating
paragraphs: An Ealing no-hot-water enquiry should say whether an immersion normally heats the water or a connected boiler supplies the cylinder coil. If unknown, a safely taken full-label photograph helps identification.

sections.heading: Choose the enquiry that matches the problem
paragraphs: The service range includes planned unvented-cylinder and Megaflo maintenance, diagnostic repairs, expansion and discharge investigations, immersion or control concerns and replacement assessments. The engineer and competence must suit the installed appliance and actual work; a brand name alone is not enough.

sections.heading: Postcode and appointment arrangements
paragraphs: Indicative nearby outward postcode areas: W5, W13. Postal boundaries do not define a guaranteed service radius. Availability is agreed for the actual postcode, system type, urgency and access. This service-area page does not represent a branch office or claim a local completed project.

sections.heading: Discuss the next step
paragraphs: Call 020 7205 4433 or prepare an email enquiry to info@g3qualifiedengineerlondon.co.uk. Include any written service findings and identify the person who can authorise work. The website does not confirm a booking, arrival time or emergency attendance.

faqs.question: Why identify direct or indirect heating before an Ealing no-hot-water visit?
faqs.answer: The heating arrangement changes the diagnostic path; electrical supplies and immersions differ from connected-boiler and coil-control investigations.
